# Linear Models Examples

Classifiers that fit a linear (or L1-regularized linear) decision boundary through the GLM framework.

> Slide deck: none yet. `d042-fundamentals.pdf` already lists "Linear Models" as one of the six classifier families in its map, but this family never received its own deck — recommend a new presentation (e.g. `d049-linear-models.pdf`).

- [17-linear-logistic-glm.md](/examples/classification/linear-models/17-linear-logistic-glm.md) - `cla_glm`: binary logistic regression through the GLM framework.
- [18-linear-logistic-glmnet.md](/examples/classification/linear-models/18-linear-logistic-glmnet.md) - `cla_glmnet`: L1-regularized logistic regression.
